prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions continue to be consistently too high compared to measured and noise-corrected results.
Sign-in reordering (sign_in, reorder) is helpful, averaging +2.2% after noise correction across 2 tests, with 1 test winning.
Evidence is still thin for adding new adoption screens (adoption, new_screen) with only 1 test, which showed no clear effect.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_screen: +0.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: +2.2% after noise correction, 2 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 76.0%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 18.6%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, hint] Account pet restore reassurance hint: Add a clear explanatory hint on the sign-in screen informing users that logging in saves and syncs their adopted pets safely to their account. (why: 8 support emails mentioned pets missing or reset after signing in again, causing confusion around account sync.)
1: [home, new_screen] Desktop pet readiness checklist: Insert a new setup checklist screen before waiting to confirm desktop display permissions and overlay readiness. (why: 3 support tickets reported pet not displaying on desktop or app failing to open, while the home step has long wait times (median 201s).)
2: [finish, redesign] Compact welcome banner with quick start guide: Redesign the home_intro screen into a compact banner highlighting simple desktop pet controls and quick tips. (why: Support emails showed post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control or hide pets, and the finish step drop-off is 64.8%.)
3: [adoption, hint] Photo upload sample guidance: Add hint text on the photo upload screen explaining best lighting and photo angles for pet creation. (why: 3 support tickets mentioned custom pet generation failing or looking wrong, and adoption step drop-off is high (60.9%).)
4: [home, redesign] Spotlight waiting screen with animated mascot tips: Redesign the waiting screen into a spotlight layout featuring interactive tip carousels during pet generation. (why: Waiting step median duration is 201s (mean 2336s); engaging users during processing helps reduce drop-offs.)
5: [choose_path, new_flow] Story scroll onboarding introduction: Rebuild the story screen into a story_scroll layout introducing the concept of desktop companions before path selection. (why: 23.8% of users drop off at choose_path screen with a mean time of 514s, indicating initial hesitation or lack of context.)
6: [sign_in, incentive] Cloud sync benefit callout badge: Add a prominent highlight badge on the sign-in screen emphasizing cloud backup protection. (why: 8 support emails complained about missing or lost pets after re-login, which can be mitigated by highlighting account save benefits.)
7: [finish, notification] Ready notification toggle on intro: Enable desktop notification options on home_intro so users are notified as soon as their pet finishes loading. (why: 3 support tickets noted that the pet failed to appear or users did not realize the app was active on screen.)
8: [choose_path, layout] Two-column path selection layout: Update choose_path layout to two_column to display adoption options cleanly side-by-side. (why: choose_path has a high mean decision time of 514s; side-by-side presentation simplifies decision-making.)

scores.note: Addresses 8 support emails regarding sign-in account sync with a low-cost hint.
New screens have weak evidence from past tests and require full release.
Finish step has a large 35.2% drop-off; compact guide helps post-onboarding confusion.
Adoption loses 39.1% of users; simple photo guidance hint is config-only.
Engaging users during 201s wait helps drop-offs, but screen redesign costs high effort.
Rebuilding story flow is expensive with unproven lift for new screen flows.
High support email volume (8) backed by sign-in drop-off, very low implementation cost.
Addresses finish drop-off and support tickets about active app awareness.
Helps high decision time (514s) at choose_path via cleaner layout.
